new_files_created.description: Full draft-07 JSON Schema for Phase 1 IR output. Extends Session 12 stub (ir.schema.json). All top-level fields required: metadata, entry_points, sources, sinks, guards, anomalies, unresolved_hooks (IR-01), coverage_gaps (A-01). source.type enum: 21 values. guards.is_effective: nullable bool. sinks.key: nullable string for stored 2-hop. version: 2.0.0.

Per-EP-group IR subset produced by slice_ir_for_group(). Derived from multi-agent-plan.md:251-268. unresolved_hooks and coverage_gaps are maxItems:0 (empty arrays in slices — handled by Agent D receiving full IR). version: 1.0.0.

Per-agent findings output schema. Canonical from skill-sets-framework.md:189-300. Full allOf conditional blocks: TP requires entry_point_id + reasoning + source/sink file/line/function; FP requires fp_reason + fp_evidence; REVIEW requires review_reason; cross-EP stored flows require load_entry_point_id + storage_key + entry_point_id=load_entry_point_id. version: 1.0.0.

Merge script output: deduplicated findings + merge_stats (total_raw, total_deduplicated, agents_included, agents_missing, tp/fp/review counts). Each finding has source_agents array tracking dedup provenance. version: 1.0.0.

Phase 3 gate input schema. Identical shape to merge-output.schema.json, duplicated explicitly (not $ref) for standalone gate validation without resolver. Decision documented in schema description. version: 1.0.0.

Schema versioning rules: semver (MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH), breaking vs non-breaking policy, migration note format, migration log for ir-output 2.0.0 and finding.schema.json stub clarification, validation code snippet, full schema-file table with producer/consumer.
